extension.description: Guides developers through a standardized workflow (analysis, implementation, review, tests, commit) integrated with GitHub Copilot Chat and records each step in a versioned file in the repository.
command.captureAnalysis: Capture requirements and plan from the chat
command.captureReviewResponse: Capture the last response as review
config.outputFolder: Folder (relative to the repository root) where workflow files are saved. Each Copilot chat session generates one file.
config.autoCaptureAnalysis: Automatically capture requirements and plan from the chat when implementation starts after Plan mode.
config.planModeNamePattern: Regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against the chat mode name to recognize Plan mode.
config.maxDiffCharacters: Maximum size (in characters) of the `git diff` included in the review prompt.
